headline: Google reports a vCenter authentication bypass was exploited as a zero-day since September
plain_summary: Google says a suspected China-linked espionage group used an unpatched flaw in VMware vCenter, and a fix is now available. A security firm also reports attacks on Cisco Expressway, which Cisco has not confirmed. CISA lists four more exploited flaws. Several bank and government data incidents remain under investigation. Organisations running these products should patch now.

items.title: VMware vCenter zero-day exploited by suspected PRC-nexus group
items.why: Google Threat Intelligence Group says CVE-2026-123890, an unauthenticated authentication bypass, was exploited from early September 2026.
items.action: Apply the Broadcom fix (VMSA-2026-0009; e.g. vCenter 8.0 U3m) now; Broadcom lists no workaround. Restrict inbound access and egress from vCenter, and hunt with the GTIG indicators.

items.title: Cisco Expressway flaw reported exploited after public proof of concept
items.why: F6 investigated an attack on exposed clustered devices; Cisco's advisory still says it knows of no malicious use.
items.action: If you run clustered Expressway, upgrade to X15.5.20 now (X14 and earlier must move to a fixed release; no workaround) and restrict TCP 4371-4372 to cluster peers.

items.title: CISA adds Synology DSM, LiteLLM, Apache Axis and REDCap flaws to exploited list
items.why: CISA cites evidence of active exploitation; The Hacker News reports ransomware on Synology NAS devices.
items.action: Find Synology DSM, LiteLLM, Apache Axis and REDCap in your environment and apply vendor fixes where they exist. Axis 1.x is end of life with no fix (migrate or apply the July 12, 2026 commit); keep Axis, LiteLLM and REDCap off the open internet until addressed.

items.title: NGINX HTTP/2 flaws allow unauthenticated code execution; exploit code is public
items.why: CERT-FR warns that CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007 can be used for remote code execution, and a public proof of concept exists for one.
items.action: Apply the fixed versions from F5 bulletins K000163926 and K000163928 (1.30.7 or 1.31.9), or disable HTTP/2 as a stopgap for the two HTTP/2 flaws only; review exposed servers for compromise.

items.title: Apache says Roller remote code execution flaw is exploited
items.why: CVE-2026-129448 is an unauthenticated deserialization bug in the XML-RPC interface affecting versions 4.0.0 to 6.1.4.
items.action: Upgrade Apache Roller to 6.1.6 or later. If you cannot, set enabledForExtensions to false in WEB-INF/web.xml, remove the /roller-services/xmlrpc mapping and restart; switching off XML-RPC in the admin UI is not enough.

items.title: WordPress 7.1.5 fixes privilege escalation and SQL injection
items.why: The project lists 20 items, including an unauthenticated privilege escalation it says could lead to remote code execution; it does not report exploitation.
items.action: Update WordPress to 7.1.5 now (Dashboard, Updates), or confirm the background auto-update ran; older branches are being backported, so watch for those releases.

items.title: JPMorgan says third-party vendors were attacked; marketing data may be exposed
items.why: The bank told Newsweek no services were disrupted; Newsweek reports the group nOn published customer email addresses.
items.action: JPMorgan customers: be wary of unexpected emails that mention your account; the bank says no financial data was involved.

items.title: European Commission says an AI-generated cyber campaign hit its systems
items.why: Detected on October 22; applications were taken offline and most are restored, and the investigation is ongoing.
